answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 3 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The lantern chain is verified at intake and sparrow publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 3 epochs old, anchored at a atlas checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 14 hours of verification and 14 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
